result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within a priority. The full `mvn -o test` run passes. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, so it's only checked by the existing tests.

The change is the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 10021). It now uses the same priority ordering as the sales-rep list. I also updated the method's Javadoc. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are filtered out as before.

The overview is the only caller of that method, so nothing else changes order.
